package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for stable_value_normalization_in_inner_loop: Stable value normalization (ToLower, TrimSpace, etc.) repeated inside inner loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

type Rule366PositiveTask struct {
	Owner string
	Tag   string
}

func scenario366Positive(owner string, tasks []Rule366PositiveTask) []string {
	var matched []string
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if strings.ToLower(owner) == strings.ToLower(task.Owner) {
			matched = append(matched, task.Tag)
		}
	}
	return matched
}
